title.zh: 卷二十三 本紀第二十三 莊烈帝一
title.raw: 卷二十三 本紀第二十三 莊烈帝一 Volume 23 Annals 23: Emperor Zhuanglie 1

sentences.zh: 莊烈帝一

translations.literal: Emperor Zhuanglie 1.
translations.idiomatic: Annals of Emperor Zhuanglie, Part One.

sentences.zh: 莊烈湣皇帝，諱由檢，光宗第五子也，萬曆三十八年十二月生。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhuanglie Min, taboo name Youjian, was Guangzong's fifth son; he was born in the twelfth month of Wanli thirty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhuanglie—honored in death with the epithet Min—was named Zhu Youjian, Guangzong's fifth son, born in the twelfth month of Wanli thirty-eight.

sentences.zh: 母賢妃劉氏，早薨。

translations.literal: His mother was Virtuous Consort Liu; she died early.
translations.idiomatic: His mother, Virtuous Consort Liu, died while he was still young.

sentences.zh: 天啟二年，封信王。

translations.literal: In Tianqi two he was enfeoffed as Prince of Xin.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Tianqi reign he was enfeoffed as Prince of Xin.

sentences.zh: 六年十一月，出居信邸。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of year six he moved out to reside at the Prince of Xin's mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Tianqi six he left the palace to live at the Prince of Xin's residence.

sentences.zh: 明年八月，熹宗疾大漸，召王入，受遺命。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the following year, when Xizong's illness grew grave, the Prince was summoned in and received the testamentary charge.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the following year, as Emperor Xizong's illness turned critical, the prince was summoned to court to receive the deathbed testament.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，即皇帝位。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: he ascended the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下，以明年為崇禎元年。

translations.literal: Amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm; the following year was made Chongzhen year one.
translations.idiomatic: He proclaimed amnesty throughout the realm and declared the following year Chongzhen one.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申，追諡生母賢妃曰孝純皇后。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiashen: the birth mother Virtuous Consort was posthumously titled Empress Xiaochun.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiashen, his birth mother Virtuous Consort Liu was posthumously honored as Empress Xiaochun.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，停刑。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai judicial executions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，冊妃周氏為皇后。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Consort Zhou was invested as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Consort Zhou was invested as empress.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲午朔，享太廟。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiawu on the new moon: sacrifice was offered at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the new moon jiawu, the emperor sacrificed to the imperial ancestors at the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，南京地震。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Nanjing was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Nanjing was struck by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲子，安置魏忠賢于鳳陽。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiazi: Wei Zhongxian was placed under restraint at Fengyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiazi, Wei Zhongxian was banished to confinement at Fengyang.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，撤各邊鎮守內臣。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: the eunuch garrison commanders on the various frontiers were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the eunuch overseers stationed on the frontier circuits were recalled.

sentences.zh: 己巳，魏忠賢縊死。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Wei Zhongxian hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Wei Zhongxian hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，免天啟時逮死諸臣贓，釋其家屬。

translations.literal: Day youyou: the fines imposed on officials executed in the Tianqi era were remitted, and their families were released.
translations.idiomatic: On youyou the court remitted the restitution levied on officials put to death in the Tianqi reign and freed their families.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，黃立極致仕。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Huang Liji retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Huang Liji retired from office.

sentences.zh: 十二月，前南京吏部侍郎錢龍錫、禮部侍郎李標、禮部尚書來宗道、吏部侍郎楊景辰、禮部侍郎周道登、少詹事劉鴻訓俱禮部尚書兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: former Vice Minister of Personnel in Nanjing Qian Longxi, Vice Minister of Rites Li Biao, Minister of Rites Lai Zongdao, Vice Minister of Personnel Yang Jingchen, Vice Minister of Rites Zhou Daodeng, and Junior Mentor Liu Hongxun were all made Ministers of Rites and Grand Secretaries of the Eastern Pavilion and took part in confidential state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month former Nanjing vice minister of personnel Qian Longxi, vice ministers of rites Li Biao and Zhou Daodeng, minister of rites Lai Zongdao, vice minister of personnel Yang Jingchen, and junior mentor Liu Hongxun were all appointed ministers of rites and grand secretaries of the Eastern Pavilion with a seat in confidential deliberations.

sentences.zh: 魏良卿、客氏子侯國興俱伏誅。

translations.literal: Wei Liangqing and Ke Shi's son Hou Guoxing were both executed.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Liangqing and Ke Shi's son Hou Guoxing were both put to death.

sentences.zh: 崇禎元年春正月辛巳，詔內臣非奉命不得出禁門。

translations.literal: Chongzhen year one, spring, first month, day xinsi: an edict forbade eunuchs to leave the forbidden gates without orders.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongzhen one, in the first month of spring, on xinsi, an edict forbade palace eunuchs to pass beyond the forbidden gates without command.

sentences.zh: 壬午，尊熹宗后為懿安皇后。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Xizong's empress was honored as Empress Yi'an.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Emperor Xizong's empress was honored as Empress Yi'an.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，戮魏忠賢及其黨崔呈秀屍。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: the corpses of Wei Zhongxian and his partisan Cui Chengxiu were disgraced and exposed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu the corpses of Wei Zhongxian and his ally Cui Chengxiu were posthumously punished and publicly displayed.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，禁章奏冗蔓。

translations.literal: Second month, day yiwei: prolix memorials were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yiwei, verbose memorials were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，禦經筵。

translations.literal: Day guichou: [the emperor] attended the Classics Lectern.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou the emperor attended the Classics Lectern.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，戒廷臣交結內侍。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: court ministers were admonished against forming ties with inner attendants.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the court was warned that ministers must not cultivate ties with palace eunuchs.

sentences.zh: 三月己巳，葬悊皇帝于德陵。

translations.literal: Third month, day jisi: the Ti Emperor was buried at Deling.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jisi, Emperor Xizong was buried at Deling.

sentences.zh: 癸未，施鳳來、張瑞圖致仕。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Shi Fenglai and Zhang Ruitu retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Shi Fenglai and Zhang Ruitu retired from office.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，贈恤冤陷諸臣。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: posthumous honors and compensation were granted to officials wrongfully condemned.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou officials who had been unjustly condemned were posthumously honored and their families compensated.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸巳，賜劉若宰等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guisi: Liu Ruozai and others were granted jinshi degrees and other ranks in differing grades.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on guisi, Liu Ruozai and others received jinshi degrees and related ranks in varying grades.

sentences.zh: 甲午，袁崇煥為兵部尚書，督師薊、遼。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Yuan Chonghuan was made Minister of War and given overall command of Ji and Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Yuan Chonghuan was appointed minister of war with overall command of the Ji and Liaodong fronts.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，指揮卓銘請開礦，不許。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Commander Zhuo Ming memorialized requesting to open mines; it was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Commander Zhuo Ming petitioned to open mines; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳，李國普致仕。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jisi: Li Guozhen retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jisi, Li Guozhen retired from office.

sentences.zh: 庚午，毀《三朝要典》。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: the Records of Three Reigns Essentials was destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the Records of Three Reigns Essentials was ordered destroyed.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，裁各部添注官，辛巳，禱雨。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: the supernumerary posts added to the ministries were cut; day xinsi: prayers were offered for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu supernumerary posts in the ministries were abolished; on xinsi the court prayed for rain.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，復外吏久任及舉保連坐之法，禁有司私派。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: the long tenure of outer officials and the law of joint responsibility in recommendations were restored; magistrates were forbidden to levy unauthorized surcharges.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou long tenure for local officials and joint liability in patronage recommendations were restored, and local magistrates were forbidden to impose unauthorized levies.

sentences.zh: 六月，削魏忠賢党馮銓、魏廣微籍。

translations.literal: Sixth month: the registers of Wei Zhongxian's partisans Feng Quan and Wei Guangwei were struck.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Feng Quan and Wei Guangwei, partisans of Wei Zhongxian, were struck from the registers.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，許顯純伏誅。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Xu Xianchun was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Xu Xianchun was executed.

sentences.zh: 壬子，來宗道、楊景辰致仕。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Lai Zongdao and Yang Jingchen retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Lai Zongdao and Yang Jingchen retired from office.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸酉，召對廷臣及袁崇煥於平臺。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guiyou: court ministers and Yuan Chonghuan were summoned to audience at the Ping Platform.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on guiyou, ministers and Yuan Chonghuan were summoned to audience at the Ping Platform.

sentences.zh: 壬午，浙江風雨，海溢，漂沒數萬人。

translations.literal: Day renwu: wind and rain struck Zhejiang; the sea overflowed, and tens of thousands were drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu storms struck Zhejiang and the sea surged inland, drowning tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 癸未，海寇鄭芝龍降。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: the sea bandit Zheng Zhilong surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the sea lord Zheng Zhilong surrendered.

sentences.zh: 甲申，寧遠兵變，巡撫都御史畢自肅自殺。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: the Ningyuan garrison mutinied; Grand Coordinator Bi Zisheng killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the Ningyuan garrison mutinied, and grand coordinator Bi Zisheng took his own life.

sentences.zh: 八月乙未，詔非盛暑祁寒，日禦文華殿與輔臣議政。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yiwei: an edict ordered that except in extreme heat or bitter cold the emperor would daily hold court at the Wenhua Hall to deliberate policy with his chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yiwei, an edict directed that except in extreme heat or bitter cold the emperor would daily meet his chief ministers at the Wenhua Hall to deliberate affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 九月丁卯，京師地震。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingmao: the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingmao, the capital was struck by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊戌，劉鴻訓罷，尋遣戍。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuxu: Liu Hongxun was dismissed and soon sent into exile.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wuxu, Liu Hongxun was dismissed and soon banished.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸未，祀天於南郊。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guiwei: Heaven was sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guiwei, the emperor sacrificed to Heaven at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙申，韓爌復入閣。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingshen: Han Kuang re-entered the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingshen, Han Kuang returned to the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 是年，革廣寧及薊鎮塞外諸部賞。

translations.literal: That year, the rewards to the outer tribes beyond Guangning and the Ji garrison were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: That year stipends to the outer tribes beyond Guangning and the Ji frontier were abolished.

sentences.zh: 諸部饑，告糴，不許。

translations.literal: The tribes were famished and petitioned to buy grain; it was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The tribes, starving, petitioned to purchase grain; permission was refused.

sentences.zh: 陝西饑民苦加派，流賊大起，分掠鄜州、延安。

translations.literal: In Shaanxi famine victims were crushed by supplemental levies; bandits rose in great numbers and raided separately through Yanzhou and Yan'an.
translations.idiomatic: In Shaanxi the famished were ruined by supplemental levies; bandits rose in force and fanned out to plunder Yanzhou and Yan'an.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丙子，釋奠于先師孔子。

translations.literal: Year two, spring, first month, day bingzi: libation was offered to the First Teacher Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, in the first month of spring, on bingzi, the emperor offered libation to Confucius as First Teacher.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，定逆案，自崔呈秀以下凡六等。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: the roster of traitors was fixed, from Cui Chengxiu downward in six grades altogether.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the treason roster was settled, ranking partisans from Cui Chengxiu downward in six grades.

sentences.zh: 二月戊子，祀社稷。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuzi: the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuzi, the emperor sacrificed at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，皇長子慈烺生，赦天下。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: the eldest imperial son Cilang was born; amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the eldest imperial son Cilang was born and amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 三月戊寅，薊州兵變，有司撫定之。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuyin: the Jizhou garrison mutinied; the local authorities pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuyin, the Jizhou garrison mutinied and was pacified by local officials.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲午，裁驛站。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiawu: the courier stations were cut.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiawu, the courier-station system was reduced.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸亥，流賊犯三水，遊擊高從龍戰歿。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day renhai: bandits attacked Sanshui; Guerrilla Commander Gao Conglong died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on renhai, bandits struck Sanshui and guerrilla commander Gao Conglong fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 癸未，祀地於北郊。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Earth was sacrificed to at the Northern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the emperor sacrificed to Earth at the Northern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 五月乙酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yiyou on the new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon yiyou in the fifth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚子，議改曆法。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: reform of the calendar was deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the court deliberated reform of the calendar.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午，袁崇煥殺毛文龍於雙島。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuwu: Yuan Chonghuan killed Mao Wenlong at Shuangdao.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuwu, Yuan Chonghuan executed Mao Wenlong at Shuangdao.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以久旱，齋居文華殿，敕群臣修省。

translations.literal: Day renhai: because of prolonged drought, [the emperor] fasted and dwelt in the Wenhua Hall and charged the ministers to examine themselves.
translations.idiomatic: On renhai, after prolonged drought, the emperor withdrew to fast in the Wenhua Hall and ordered his ministers to examine their conduct.

sentences.zh: 秋八月甲子，總兵官侯良柱、兵備副使劉可訓擊斬奢崇明、安邦彥於紅土川，水西賊平。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, day jiazi: Regional Commander Hou Liangzhu and Vice Commissioner for Military Affairs Liu Kexun attacked and beheaded She Chongming and An Bangyan at Hongtu River; the bandits of Shuixi were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on jiazi, regional commander Hou Liangzhu and vice commissioner Liu Kexun killed She Chongming and An Bangyan at Hongtu River, pacifying the Shuixi rebels.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，熹宗神主祔太廟。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Xizong's spirit tablet was enshrined in the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Emperor Xizong's spirit tablet was placed in the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 九月丁未，楊鎬棄市。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingwei: Yang Hao was executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingwei, Yang Hao was executed in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊寅，大清兵入大安口。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuyin: Great Qing forces entered Da'an Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wuyin, Great Qing armies entered Da'an Pass.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午朔，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renwu on the new moon: the capital was placed under martial alert.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon renwu in the eleventh month the capital went on martial alert.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，山海關總兵官趙率教戰沒於遵化。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Shanhaiguan Regional Commander Zhao Shuaijiao died in battle at Zunhua.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Shanhaiguan regional commander Zhao Shuaijiao fell in battle at Zunhua.

sentences.zh: 甲申，大清兵入遵化，巡撫都御史王元雅、推官何天球等死之。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Great Qing forces entered Zunhua; Grand Coordinator Wang Yuanya, Assistant Magistrate He Tianqiu, and others died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Great Qing forces took Zunhua; grand coordinator Wang Yuanya, assistant magistrate He Tianqiu, and others were killed.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，總兵官滿桂入援。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Regional Commander Man Gui entered to relieve the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai regional commander Man Gui marched in relief of the capital.

sentences.zh: 己丑，吏部侍郎成基命為禮部尚書兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Vice Minister of Personnel Cheng Jiming was made Minister of Rites and Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion and took part in confidential state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou vice minister of personnel Cheng Jiming was made minister of rites and grand secretary of the Eastern Pavilion with a seat in confidential deliberations.

sentences.zh: 召前大學士孫承宗為兵部尚書中極殿大學士，視師通州。

translations.literal: Former Grand Secretary Sun Chengzong was recalled as Minister of War and Grand Secretary of the Zhongji Hall and took command at Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Former grand secretary Sun Chengzong was recalled as minister of war and grand secretary of the Zhongji Hall to take command at Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，袁崇煥入援，次薊州。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Yuan Chonghuan entered in relief and halted at Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Yuan Chonghuan marched to relieve the capital and encamped at Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊子，宣、大、保定兵相繼入援。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: troops from Xuanfu, Datong, and Baoding entered in relief one after another.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi relief columns from Xuanfu, Datong, and Baoding reached the capital in succession.

sentences.zh: 征天下鎮巡官勤王。

translations.literal: Regional and circuit officials throughout the realm were summoned to rush to the emperor's defense.
translations.idiomatic: Military governors and circuit commissioners throughout the realm were ordered to hurry to the emperor's defense.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，大清兵薄德勝門。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Great Qing forces pressed close to Desheng Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Great Qing forces pressed up to Desheng Gate.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，召袁崇煥等於平臺，崇煥請入城休兵，不許。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Yuan Chonghuan and others were summoned to audience at the Ping Platform; Chonghuan requested to enter the city to rest his troops; it was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Yuan Chonghuan and others were summoned to audience at the Ping Platform; Chonghuan asked to bring his troops within the walls to rest, but permission was refused.

sentences.zh: 下兵部尚書王洽于獄。

translations.literal: Minister of War Wang Qia was cast into prison.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of war Wang Qia was thrown into prison.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛亥朔，再召袁崇煥於平臺，下錦衣衛獄。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinhai on the new moon: Yuan Chonghuan was again summoned to audience at the Ping Platform and cast into the Embroidered Uniform Guard prison.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon xinhai in the twelfth month Yuan Chonghuan was again summoned to the Ping Platform and then imprisoned in the Embroidered Uniform Guard jail.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，總兵官祖大壽兵潰，東出關。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Regional Commander Zu Dashou's army collapsed and fled east out of the pass.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin regional commander Zu Dashou's army broke and fled eastward out of the pass.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，孫承宗移駐山海關。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Sun Chengzong shifted his headquarters to Shanhaiguan.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Sun Chengzong moved his headquarters to Shanhaiguan.

sentences.zh: 庚申，諭廷臣進馬。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: court ministers were instructed to present horses.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the court ordered ministers to contribute horses.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，遣中官趨滿桂出戰，桂及前總兵官孫祖壽俱戰歿。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: eunuchs were dispatched to urge Man Gui into battle; Gui and former Regional Commander Sun Zushou both died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao palace eunuchs were sent to hurry Man Gui into battle; Gui and former regional commander Sun Zushou both fell fighting.

sentences.zh: 總兵官馬世龍總理援軍。

translations.literal: Regional Commander Ma Shilong took overall charge of the relief armies.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commander Ma Shilong was placed in overall charge of the relief armies.

sentences.zh: 壬申，錢龍錫罷。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Qian Longxi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Qian Longxi was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，山西援兵潰於良鄉。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: the Shanxi relief army collapsed at Liangxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the Shanxi relief force broke at Liangxiang.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，禮部侍郎周延儒、尚書何如寵、侍郎錢象坤俱禮部尚書兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Vice Minister of Rites Zhou Yanru, Minister He Ruchong, and Vice Minister Qian Xiangkun were all made Ministers of Rites and Grand Secretaries of the Eastern Pavilion and took part in confidential state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou vice minister of rites Zhou Yanru, minister He Ruchong, and vice minister Qian Xiangkun were all appointed ministers of rites and grand secretaries of the Eastern Pavilion with seats in confidential deliberations.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月甲申，大清兵克永平，副使鄭國昌、知府張鳳奇等死之。

translations.literal: Year three, spring, first month, day jiashen: Great Qing forces took Yongping; Vice Commissioner Zheng Guochang, Prefect Zhang Fengqi, and others died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the first month of spring, on jiashen, Great Qing forces captured Yongping; vice commissioner Zheng Guochang, prefect Zhang Fengqi, and others were killed.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，瘞城外戰士骸。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: outside the walls the bones of fallen soldiers were buried.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu the remains of soldiers slain outside the walls were interred.

sentences.zh: 戊子，大清兵克灤州。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Great Qing forces took Luanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Great Qing forces captured Luanzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，逮總督薊遼都御史劉策下獄，論死。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Governor-General of Ji and Liaodong Liu Ce was arrested and cast into prison, condemned to death.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin governor-general of Ji and Liaodong Liu Ce was arrested, imprisoned, and sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 乙未，禁抄傳邊報。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: unauthorized copying and circulation of frontier reports was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei unauthorized copying and circulation of frontier intelligence was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 韓爌致仕。

translations.literal: Han Kuang retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: Han Kuang stepped down from the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，兵部右侍郎劉之綸敗沒於遵化。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Vice Minister of War Liu Zhilun was defeated and died at Zunhua.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin vice minister of war Liu Zhilun was defeated and killed at Zunhua.

sentences.zh: 是月，陝西諸路總兵官吳自勉等帥師入衛，延綏、甘肅兵潰西去，與群寇合。

translations.literal: That month, regional commanders of the various Shaanxi circuits including Wu Zimian led troops in to guard the capital; the Yan'an and Gansu armies collapsed westward and joined the mass of bandits.
translations.idiomatic: That month regional commanders of the Shaanxi circuits, including Wu Zimian, marched east to defend the capital, while the Yan'an and Gansu columns broke westward and merged with the bandit hosts.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，立皇長子慈烺為皇太子，大赦。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengshen: the eldest imperial son Cilang was installed as heir apparent; a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengshen, the eldest imperial son Cilang was installed as heir apparent and a great amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 三月壬午，李標緻仕。

translations.literal: Third month, day renwu: Li Biao retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renwu, Li Biao retired from office.

sentences.zh: 戊申，流賊犯山西。

translations.literal: Day wushen: bandits attacked Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen bandits raided Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙卯，以久旱，齋居文華殿，諭百官修省。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yimao: because of prolonged drought, [the emperor] fasted and dwelt in the Wenhua Hall and instructed the hundred officials to examine themselves.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yimao, after prolonged drought the emperor withdrew to fast in the Wenhua Hall and urged all officials to examine their conduct.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，流賊陷蒲縣。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: roving rebels took Puxian.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou roving rebels captured Puxian.

sentences.zh: 五月辛卯，馬世龍、祖大壽諸軍入灤州。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinmao: the armies of Ma Shilong, Zu Dashou, and others entered Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on xinmao, the armies of Ma Shilong, Zu Dashou, and others entered Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，大清兵東歸，永平、遷安、遵化相繼復。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Qing forces returned east; Yongping, Qian'an, and Zunhua were recovered in succession.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Qing forces withdrew eastward, and Yongping, Qian'an, and Zunhua were recovered one after another.

sentences.zh: 六月癸丑，流賊王嘉胤陷府谷，米脂賊張獻忠聚眾應之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guichou: the roving rebel Wang Jiayin took Fugu; Zhang Xianzhong of Mizhi gathered followers and joined him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guichou, the roving rebel Wang Jiayin captured Fugu, and Zhang Xianzhong of Mizhi raised a following to join him.

sentences.zh: 己未，授宋儒邵雍後裔《五經》博士。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: a descendant of the Song Confucian Shao Yong was appointed Erudite of the Five Classics.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei a descendant of the Song scholar Shao Yong was appointed Erudite of the Five Classics.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，禮部尚書溫體仁、吳宗達並兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Ministers of Rites Wen Tiren and Wu Zongda were both made grand secretaries of the Eastern Pavilion and joined in affairs of state.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Ministers of Rites Wen Tiren and Wu Zongda were both made grand secretaries of the Eastern Pavilion and joined in affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 秋八月癸亥，殺袁崇煥。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, day guihai: Yuan Chonghuan was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on guihai, Yuan Chonghuan was put to death.

sentences.zh: 九月己卯，逮錢龍錫下獄。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jimao: Qian Longxi was arrested and cast into prison.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jimao, Qian Longxi was arrested and imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸亥，停刑。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guihai: executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on guihai, executions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，巡撫延綏副都御史洪承疇、總兵官杜文煥敗賊張獻忠於清澗。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Grand Coordinator of Yansui and Vice Censor-in-Chief Hong Chengchou and Regional Commander Du Wenhuan defeated the rebel Zhang Xianzhong at Qingjian.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Grand Coordinator Hong Chengchou of Yansui, Vice Censor-in-Chief, and Regional Commander Du Wenhuan defeated Zhang Xianzhong's rebels at Qingjian.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，破賊于懷寧。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renchen: rebels were defeated at Huaining.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renchen, rebels were defeated at Huaining.

sentences.zh: 甲午，山西總兵官王國梁追賊于河曲，敗績。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Shanxi Regional Commander Wang Guoliang pursued rebels at Hequ and suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Shanxi Regional Commander Wang Guoliang pursued rebels at Hequ and suffered defeat.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙巳朔，增田賦充餉。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yisi new moon: land tax was increased to fill the war chest.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi new moon of the twelfth month land tax was raised to fund military supplies.

sentences.zh: 戊午，流賊陷寧塞。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: roving rebels took Ningsai.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu roving rebels captured Ningsai.

sentences.zh: 是年，烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year U-Tsang sent a tribute mission.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月己卯，流賊陷保安。

translations.literal: Year four, spring, first month, day jimao: roving rebels took Bao'an.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Chongzhen four, on jimao of the first month, roving rebels captured Bao'an.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，御史吳甡振延綏饑民。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Censor Wu Shen organized relief for the famine-stricken people of Yansui.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Censor Wu Shen organized relief for the famine victims of Yansui.

sentences.zh: 己亥，召對內閣、九卿、科道及入覲兩司官于文華殿。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the Emperor summoned the Grand Secretariat, the Nine Ministers, supervising secretaries and censors, and provincial officials attending court at the Wenhua Hall for audience.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the Emperor held audience at the Wenhua Hall with the Grand Secretariat, the Nine Ministers, supervising secretaries and censors, and provincial officials who had come to court.

sentences.zh: 命都察院嚴核巡按御史。

translations.literal: He ordered the Censorate strictly to audit touring investigating censors.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the Censorate to conduct a strict audit of touring investigating censors.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子，流賊圍慶陽，分兵陷合水。

translations.literal: Second month, day renzi: roving rebels besieged Qingyang and detached forces took Heshui.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renzi, roving rebels besieged Qingyang while detached columns captured Heshui.

sentences.zh: 三月丁丑，副將張應昌等擊敗之，慶陽圍解。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingchou: Vice General Zhang Yingchang and others defeated them, and the siege of Qingyang was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingchou, Vice General Zhang Yingchang and others defeated them and lifted the siege of Qingyang.

sentences.zh: 癸未，總督陝西三邊軍務侍郎楊鶴招撫流賊于寧州，群賊偽降，尋復叛。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Yang He, Commissioner for Military Affairs of the Three Frontiers in Shaanxi and Vice Minister, induced roving rebels to submit at Ningzhou; the rebel bands feigned surrender and soon rebelled again.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Yang He, commissioner for the Three Frontiers in Shaanxi, induced roving rebels to submit at Ningzhou; the bands feigned surrender and soon rose again.

sentences.zh: 己丑，賜陳于泰等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Chen Yutai and other metropolitan graduates were granted the jinshi degree and official ranks in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Chen Yutai and other metropolitan graduates were granted the jinshi degree and appointed to office in varying ranks.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚戌，禱雨。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengxu: prayers for rain were offered.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on gengxu, prayers for rain were offered.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔廷臣條時政。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: an edict ordered court ministers to set forth current policy in articles.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou an edict ordered court ministers to submit written proposals on current policy.

sentences.zh: 是月，延綏副將曹文詔擊賊于河曲，王嘉胤敗死。

translations.literal: That month Yansui Vice General Cao Wenbiao attacked rebels at Hequ, and Wang Jiayin was defeated and killed.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yansui Vice General Cao Wenbiao attacked rebels at Hequ, and Wang Jiayin was defeated and killed.

sentences.zh: 五月甲戌朔，步禱於南郊。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiaxu new moon: the foot ritual to pray for rain was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu new moon of the fifth month the foot ritual to pray for rain was performed at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，戍錢龍錫。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Qian Longxi was banished to frontier service.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Qian Longxi was banished to frontier service.

sentences.zh: 六月丁未，錢象坤致仕。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingwei: Qian Xiangkun retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingwei, Qian Xiangkun retired from office.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲戌，總兵官王際恩敗賊於鄜州，降賊首上天龍。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiaxu: Regional Commander Wang Jien defeated rebels at Fuzhou and received the surrender of the rebel chieftain Shang Tianlong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiaxu, Regional Commander Wang Jien defeated rebels at Fuzhou and received the surrender of the rebel chieftain Shang Tianlong.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，總兵官賀虎臣擊斬賊劉六於慶陽。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day maoyin: Regional Commander He Huchen attacked and beheaded the rebel Liu Liu at Qingyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on maoyin, Regional Commander He Huchen attacked and beheaded the rebel Liu Liu at Qingyang.

sentences.zh: 丁未，大清兵圍祖大壽于大淩城。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Qing forces besieged Zu Dashou at Daling Fort.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Qing forces besieged Zu Dashou at Daling Fort.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，何如寵致仕。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: He Ruchong retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen He Ruchong retired from office.

sentences.zh: 九月庚辰，內臣王應朝、鄧希詔等監視關、寧、薊鎮兵糧及各邊撫賞。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengchen: inner eunuchs Wang Yingchao, Deng Xizhao, and others were assigned to supervise grain for troops at Shan, Ning, and Ji garrisons and frontier reward payments.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengchen, inner eunuchs Wang Yingchao, Deng Xizhao, and others were posted to supervise troop grain at the Shan, Ning, and Ji garrisons and frontier reward payments.

sentences.zh: 甲午，逮楊鶴下獄，論戍。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Yang He was arrested and cast into prison and sentenced to frontier banishment.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Yang He was arrested, imprisoned, and sentenced to frontier banishment.

sentences.zh: 洪承疇總督三邊軍務。

translations.literal: Hong Chengchou became commissioner for Three Frontiers military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Chengchou was made commissioner for Three Frontiers military affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，太監張彝憲總理戶、工二部錢糧，給事中宋可久等相繼諫，不聽。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: the eunuch Zhang Yixian was put in overall charge of the treasuries of the Ministries of Revenue and Works; Supervising Secretary Song Kejiu and others remonstrated in succession, but the Emperor would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the eunuch Zhang Yixian was put in overall charge of the treasuries of the Ministries of Revenue and Works; Supervising Secretary Song Kejiu and others remonstrated in succession, but the emperor would not listen.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，山海總兵官宋偉等援大淩，敗於長山，監軍太僕少卿張春被執。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Shanhai Regional Commander Song Wei and others went to relieve Daling, were defeated at Changshan, and Supervising Secretary of the Court of Imperial Studs Zhang Chun, who oversaw the army, was taken captive.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Shanhai Regional Commander Song Wei and others marched to relieve Daling, were defeated at Changshan, and Zhang Chun, supervising secretary of the Court of Imperial Studs who oversaw the army, was taken captive.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinchou new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou new moon of the tenth month of winter there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，祖大壽殺副將何可綱。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Zu Dashou killed Vice General He Kegang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Zu Dashou killed Vice General He Kegang.

sentences.zh: 己巳，大壽自大淩脫歸，入錦州。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Dashou broke out of Daling and returned, entering Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Dashou broke out of Daling and returned to Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙戌，太監李奇茂監視陝西茶馬，吳直監視登島兵糧、海禁，群臣合疏諫，不聽。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingxu: the eunuch Li Qimao was assigned to supervise Shaanxi tea and horses; Wu Zhi was assigned to supervise Deng-Lai troop grain and maritime prohibitions; the ministers submitted a joint memorial remonstrating, but the Emperor would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingxu, the eunuch Li Qimao was posted to supervise Shaanxi tea and horses and Wu Zhi to supervise Deng-Lai troop grain and maritime prohibitions; the ministers submitted a joint memorial of remonstrance, but the emperor would not listen.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，孫承宗致仕。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Sun Chengzong retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Sun Chengzong retired from office.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，召對廷臣于文華殿，曆詢軍國諸務。

translations.literal: Day guisi: the Emperor summoned court ministers to audience at the Wenhua Hall and questioned them in turn on military and state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the emperor summoned court ministers to audience at the Wenhua Hall and questioned them in turn on military and state affairs.

sentences.zh: 語及內臣，帝曰：「諸臣若實心任事，朕亦何需此輩。

translations.literal: When the talk turned to inner eunuchs, the Emperor said: "If the ministers would truly devote themselves to their duties, what need would I have for this lot.
translations.idiomatic: When the talk turned to inner eunuchs, the emperor said, "If my ministers would truly devote themselves to their duties, what need would I have for this lot?

sentences.zh: 」己亥，流賊羅汝才犯山西。

translations.literal: " Day jihai: roving rebels led by Luo Rucai invaded Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai roving rebels led by Luo Rucai invaded Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙丑，陝西降賊復叛，陷甘泉，殺參政張允登。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day yichou: surrendered rebels in Shaanxi rebelled again, took Ganquan, and killed Administration Vice Commissioner Zhang Yundeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on yichou, surrendered rebels in Shaanxi rose again, captured Ganquan, and killed Administration Vice Commissioner Zhang Yundeng.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，登州遊擊孔有德率師援遼，次吳橋反，陷陵縣，連陷臨邑、商河、齊東，屠新城。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Dengzhou Guerrilla Commander Kong Youde led troops to relieve Liaodong; halting at Wuqiao he mutinied, took Ling County, and in succession took Linyi, Shanghe, and Qidong, slaughtering the people of Xincheng.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Dengzhou Guerrilla Commander Kong Youde led troops to relieve Liaodong; halting at Wuqiao he mutinied, captured Ling County, and in succession took Linyi, Shanghe, and Qidong, massacring the people of Xincheng.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙子，濟南官軍禦賊于阮城店，敗績。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingzi: government troops of Jinan resisted the rebels at Ruancheng Station and suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingzi, Jinan government troops met the rebels at Ruancheng Station and suffered defeat.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以大淩築城招釁奪孫承宗官。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: because building the fort at Daling had provoked hostilities, Sun Chengzong was stripped of rank.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, because fortifying Daling had provoked hostilities, Sun Chengzong was stripped of rank.

sentences.zh: 是冬，延安、慶陽大雪，民饑，盜賊益熾。

translations.literal: That winter heavy snow fell in Yan'an and Qingyang; the people starved, and banditry grew fiercer.
translations.idiomatic: That winter heavy snow fell in Yan'an and Qingyang; the people went hungry, and banditry grew fiercer.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月辛丑，孔有德陷登州，遊擊陳良謨戰死，總兵官張可大死之。

translations.literal: Year five, spring, first month, day xinchou: Kong Youde took Dengzhou; Guerrilla Commander Chen Liangmo died fighting, and Regional Commander Zhang Kedai died in the affair.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Chongzhen five, on xinchou of the first month, Kong Youde captured Dengzhou; Guerrilla Commander Chen Liangmo died fighting, and Regional Commander Zhang Kedai died in the affair.

sentences.zh: 巡撫都御史孫元化、副使宋光蘭等被執，尋縱還。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Sun Yuanhua, Vice Commissioner Song Guanglan, and others were seized and soon released.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Sun Yuanhua, Vice Commissioner Song Guanglan, and others were taken captive and soon released.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，孔有德陷黃縣。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Kong Youde took Huang County.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Kong Youde captured Huang County.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，總兵官楊禦蕃、王洪率師討孔有德，敗績於新城鎮。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Regional Commanders Yang Yufan and Wang Hong led troops to campaign against Kong Youde and suffered defeat at Xincheng Town.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Regional Commanders Yang Yufan and Wang Hong led troops against Kong Youde and suffered defeat at Xincheng Town.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳朔，孔有德圍萊州，巡撫都御史徐從治固守。

translations.literal: Second month, day jisi new moon: Kong Youde besieged Laizhou; Grand Coordinator Xu Congzhi held firm.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi new moon of the second month Kong Youde besieged Laizhou, and Grand Coordinator Xu Congzhi held firm.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，孔有德陷平度。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Kong Youde took Pingdu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Kong Youde captured Pingdu.

sentences.zh: 三月壬寅，兵部侍郎劉宇烈督理山東軍務，討孔有德。

translations.literal: Third month, day renyin: Vice Minister of War Liu Yulie took charge of Shandong military affairs and campaigned against Kong Youde.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renyin, Vice Minister of War Liu Yulie took charge of Shandong military affairs to campaign against Kong Youde.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲戌，劉宇烈敗績於沙河。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiaxu: Liu Yulie suffered defeat at Shahe.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiaxu, Liu Yulie suffered defeat at Shahe.

sentences.zh: 癸未，徐從治中傷卒。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Xu Congzhi died of wounds received.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Xu Congzhi died of his wounds.

sentences.zh: 是月，總兵官曹文詔、楊嘉謨連破賊于隴安、靜寧，賊奔水落城，平涼、莊浪饑民附之，勢復熾。

translations.literal: That month Regional Commanders Cao Wenbiao and Yang Jiamou repeatedly defeated rebels at Long'an and Jingning; the rebels fled to Shuiluo Fort, and famine-stricken people of Pingliang and Zhuanglang joined them, and their power revived.
translations.idiomatic: That month Regional Commanders Cao Wenbiao and Yang Jiamou repeatedly defeated rebels at Long'an and Jingning; the rebels fled to Shuiluo Fort, famine victims of Pingliang and Zhuanglang rallied to them, and their power revived.

sentences.zh: 五月丙午，參政硃大典為僉都御史，巡撫山東。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingwu: Administration Vice Commissioner Zhu Dadian was made Assistant Censor-in-Chief and Grand Coordinator of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingwu, Administration Vice Commissioner Zhu Dadian was made assistant censor-in-chief and grand coordinator of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，禮部尚書鄭以偉、徐光啟並兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Ministers of Rites Zheng Yiwei and Xu Guangqi were both made grand secretaries of the Eastern Pavilion and joined in affairs of state.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Ministers of Rites Zheng Yiwei and Xu Guangqi were both made grand secretaries of the Eastern Pavilion and joined in affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 六月，京師大雨水。

translations.literal: Sixth month: heavy rain fell in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month heavy rains fell in the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬申，河決孟津。

translations.literal: Day renshen: the Yellow River burst its banks at Mengjin.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the Yellow River burst its banks at Mengjin.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛丑，太監曹化淳提督京營戎政。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinchou: the eunuch Cao Huachun was made director of military administration for the capital garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinchou, the eunuch Cao Huachun was made director of military administration for the capital garrisons.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，孔有德偽降，誘執登萊巡撫都御史謝璉，萊州知府硃萬年死之。

translations.literal: Day maoyin: Kong Youde feigned surrender, lured and seized Deng-Lai Grand Coordinator Xie Lian, and Laizhou Prefect Zhu Wannian died in the affair.
translations.idiomatic: On maoyin Kong Youde feigned surrender, lured and seized Deng-Lai Grand Coordinator Xie Lian, and Laizhou Prefect Zhu Wannian died in the affair.

sentences.zh: 己未，孫元化棄市。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Sun Yuanhua was executed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Sun Yuanhua was executed in the market.

sentences.zh: 逮劉宇烈下獄，論戍。

translations.literal: Liu Yulie was arrested and cast into prison and sentenced to frontier banishment.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yulie was arrested, imprisoned, and sentenced to frontier banishment.

sentences.zh: 八月甲戌，洪承疇敗賊於甘泉，賊首白廣恩降。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiaxu: Hong Chengchou defeated rebels at Ganquan, and the rebel chieftain Bai Guang'en surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiaxu, Hong Chengchou defeated rebels at Ganquan, and the rebel chieftain Bai Guang'en surrendered.

sentences.zh: 甲申，硃大典督軍救萊州，前鋒參將祖寬敗賊於沙河。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Zhu Dadian led troops to relieve Laizhou; Vanguard Commander Zu Kuan defeated rebels at Shahe.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Zhu Dadian led troops to relieve Laizhou, and Vanguard Commander Zu Kuan defeated rebels at Shahe.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，萊州圍解。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: the siege of Laizhou was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the siege of Laizhou was lifted.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，官軍大敗孔有德于黃縣，進圍登州。

translations.literal: Day guisi: government troops inflicted a great defeat on Kong Youde at Huang County and advanced to besiege Dengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi government troops inflicted a great defeat on Kong Youde at Huang County and advanced to besiege Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉，海賊劉香寇福建。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingyou: the sea rebel Liu Xiang raided Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingyou, the sea rebel Liu Xiang raided Fujian.

sentences.zh: 是秋，陝西賊入山西，連陷大寧、澤州、壽陽，分部走河北，犯懷慶，陷修武。

translations.literal: That autumn Shaanxi rebels entered Shanxi, took Daning, Zezhou, and Shouyang in succession, detached columns went into Hebei, invaded Huaiqing, and took Xiuwu.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Shaanxi rebels entered Shanxi, captured Daning, Zezhou, and Shouyang in succession, sent columns into Hebei, invaded Huaiqing, and took Xiuwu.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月戊戌，劉香寇浙江。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, day wuxu: Liu Xiang raided Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on wuxu, Liu Xiang raided Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月癸卯，曹文詔節制山、陝諸將討賊。

translations.literal: Year six, spring, first month, day maoyin: Cao Wenbiao was placed in overall command of the generals of Shanxi and Shaanxi to campaign against rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Chongzhen six, on maoyin of the first month, Cao Wenbiao was placed in overall command of the generals of Shanxi and Shaanxi to campaign against rebels.

sentences.zh: 丁未，副將左良玉破賊於涉縣，賊走林縣山中，饑民爭附之。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Vice General Zuo Liangyu defeated rebels at She County; the rebels fled into the mountains of Lin County, and famine victims vied to join them.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Vice General Zuo Liangyu defeated rebels at She County; the rebels fled into the mountains of Lin County, and famine victims vied to join them.

sentences.zh: 庚申，遣使分督直省逋賦。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: envoys were dispatched to supervise overdue taxes in the provinces under direct administration.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen envoys were dispatched to supervise collection of overdue taxes in the directly administered provinces.

sentences.zh: 是月，曹文詔擊山西賊，屢敗之。

translations.literal: That month Cao Wenbiao attacked Shanxi rebels and repeatedly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: That month Cao Wenbiao attacked Shanxi rebels and repeatedly defeated them.

sentences.zh: 二月壬申，削左副都御史王志道籍。

translations.literal: Second month, day renshen: Left Vice Censor-in-Chief Wang Zhidao was struck from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renshen, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief Wang Zhidao was struck from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，流賊犯畿南。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: roving rebels invaded the region south of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou roving rebels invaded the region south of the capital.

sentences.zh: 戊子，總兵官陳洪範等克登州水城。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Regional Commander Chen Hongfan and others took Dengzhou's water fort.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Regional Commander Chen Hongfan and others captured Dengzhou's water fort.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，孔有德遁入海，山東平。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Kong Youde fled by sea; Shandong was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Kong Youde fled by sea, and Shandong was pacified.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳，敕曹文詔諸將限三月平賊。

translations.literal: Third month, day guisi: an edict ordered Cao Wenbiao and the generals to suppress the rebels within three months.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guisi, an edict ordered Cao Wenbiao and the generals to suppress the rebels within three months.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己巳，免延安、慶陽、平涼新舊遼餉。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jisi: old and new Liaodong levies were remitted in Yan'an, Qingyang, and Pingliang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jisi, old and new Liaodong levies were remitted in Yan'an, Qingyang, and Pingliang.

sentences.zh: 壬申，總兵官鄧巳、左良玉剿河南賊。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Regional Commanders Deng Qi and Zuo Liangyu campaigned against Henan rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Regional Commanders Deng Qi and Zuo Liangyu campaigned against Henan rebels.

sentences.zh: 五月乙巳，太監陳大金等分監曹文詔、張應昌、左良玉、鄧巳軍。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yisi: the eunuchs Chen Dajin and others were assigned in separate posts to supervise the armies of Cao Wenbiao, Zhang Yingchang, Zuo Liangyu, and Deng Qi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yisi, the eunuchs Chen Dajin and others were posted in separate assignments to supervise the armies of Cao Wenbiao, Zhang Yingchang, Zuo Liangyu, and Deng Qi.

sentences.zh: 壬子，孔有德及其党耿仲明等航海降於我大清。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Kong Youde and his followers Geng Zhongming and others went by sea and surrendered to our Great Qing.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Kong Youde and his followers Geng Zhongming and others put to sea and surrendered to our Great Qing.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，河套部犯寧夏，總兵官賀虎臣戰沒。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Ordos tribes invaded Ningxia; Regional Commander He Huchen fell in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Ordos tribes invaded Ningxia, and Regional Commander He Huchen fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉朔，太監高起潛監視寧、錦兵餉。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinyou new moon: the eunuch Gao Qiqian was assigned to supervise grain for troops at Ning and Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou new moon of the sixth month the eunuch Gao Qiqian was posted to supervise troop grain at Ning and Jin.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，鄭以偉卒。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Zheng Yiwei died.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Zheng Yiwei died.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，周延儒致仕。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Zhou Yanru retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Zhou Yanru retired from office.

sentences.zh: 甲申，延綏副將李卑援剿河南。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Yansui Vice General Li Bei went to reinforce the campaign in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Yansui Vice General Li Bei went to reinforce the campaign in Henan.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，太監張彝憲請催逋賦一千七百余萬，給事中範淑泰諫，不聽。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: the eunuch Zhang Yixian requested collection of more than seventeen million in overdue taxes; Supervising Secretary Fan Shutai remonstrated, but the Emperor would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the eunuch Zhang Yixian requested collection of more than seventeen million in overdue taxes; Supervising Secretary Fan Shutai remonstrated, but the emperor would not listen.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，大清兵取旅順，總兵官黃龍死之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiachen: Qing forces took Lüshun; Regional Commander Huang Long died in the affair.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiachen, Qing forces took Lüshun, and Regional Commander Huang Long died in the affair.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，改曹文詔鎮大同，山西巡撫都御史許鼎臣請留文詔剿賊，不許。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Cao Wenbiao was transferred to command at Datong; Shanxi Grand Coordinator Xu Dingchen requested that Wenbiao be kept to suppress rebels, but permission was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Cao Wenbiao was transferred to command at Datong; Shanxi Grand Coordinator Xu Dingchen asked that Wenbiao be kept to suppress rebels, but the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 八月己巳，曹文詔敗賊於濟源，又敗之于懷慶。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jisi: Cao Wenbiao defeated rebels at Jiyuan and again defeated them at Huaiqing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jisi, Cao Wenbiao defeated rebels at Jiyuan and again defeated them at Huaiqing.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌，南京禮部侍郎錢士升為禮部尚書兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengxu: Qian Shisheng, Vice Minister of Rites at Nanjing, was made Minister of Rites and grand secretary of the Eastern Pavilion and joined in affairs of state.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengxu, Qian Shisheng, Vice Minister of Rites at Nanjing, was made Minister of Rites and grand secretary of the Eastern Pavilion and joined in affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊辰，徐光啟卒。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuchen: Xu Guangqi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wuchen, Xu Guangqi died.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸巳，禮部侍郎王應熊、何吾騶俱禮部尚書兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guisi: Vice Ministers of Rites Wang Yingxiong and He Wuyao were both made Ministers of Rites and Grand Secretaries of the Eastern Pavilion, participating in confidential affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guisi, Vice Ministers of Rites Wang Yingxiong and He Wuyao were both made ministers of rites and grand secretaries of the Eastern Pavilion with a seat in confidential state affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔保定、河南、山西會兵剿賊。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: an edict ordered Baoding, Henan, and Shanxi to combine forces to suppress the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the court ordered Baoding, Henan, and Shanxi to unite their armies against the bandits.

sentences.zh: 壬子，賊渡河。

translations.literal: Day renzi: the bandits crossed the river.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the bandits crossed the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，陷澠池。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Mianchi fell.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Mianchi was taken.

sentences.zh: 十二月，連陷伊陽、盧氏，分犯南陽、汝寧，遂逼湖廣。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: Yiyang and Lushi fell in succession; detachments raided Nanyang and Runing, then pressed into Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Yiyang and Lushi fell in turn; raiding columns struck Nanyang and Runing and then drove into Huguang.

sentences.zh: 是年，安南入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Annam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Annam presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月己丑，廣鹿島副將尚可喜降於我大清。

translations.literal: Seventh year, spring, first month, day jichou: Shang Kexi, deputy general of Guanglu Island, surrendered to our Great Qing.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, spring, first month, on jichou, Guanglu Island deputy general Shang Kexi surrendered to our Great Qing.

sentences.zh: 設河南、山、陝、川、湖五省總督，以延綏巡撫陳奇瑜兼兵部侍郎為之。

translations.literal: A supreme commander for the five provinces of Henan, Shanxi, Shaanxi, Sichuan, and Huguang was established; Yansui grand coordinator Chen Qiyu was additionally made Vice Minister of War and appointed to the post.
translations.idiomatic: The court created a supreme commander for Henan, Shanxi, Shaanxi, Sichuan, and Huguang, appointing Yansui grand coordinator Chen Qiyu as vice minister of war to the post.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，總兵官張應昌渡河，敗賊於靈寶。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Regional Commander Zhang Yingchang crossed the river and defeated the bandits at Lingbao.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin regional commander Zhang Yingchang crossed the river and routed the bandits at Lingbao.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，賊自鄖陽渡漢。

translations.literal: Day renchen: the bandits crossed the Han from Yunyang.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the bandits crossed the Han from Yunyang.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，犯襄陽，連陷紫陽、平利、白河，南入四川。

translations.literal: Day guisi: they struck Xiangyang, then took Ziyang, Pingli, and Baihe in succession and pushed south into Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi they struck Xiangyang, seized Ziyang, Pingli, and Baihe in succession, and drove south into Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 二月戊寅，陷夔州，大寧諸縣皆失守。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuyin: Kuizhou fell, and the counties of Daning were all lost.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuyin, Kuizhou fell and the counties of Daning were all lost.

sentences.zh: 甲申，耕耤田。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: the emperor plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the emperor performed the spring plowing at the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，張獻忠突商、雒，凡十三營流入漢南。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Zhang Xianzhong burst into Shang and Luo; in all, thirteen camps poured into southern Han.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Zhang Xianzhong burst into Shangzhou and Luozhou; thirteen rebel camps in all streamed into southern Han.

sentences.zh: 是月，振登、萊饑，蠲逋賦。

translations.literal: That month, famine struck Deng and Lai; overdue taxes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month famine struck Dengzhou and Laizhou, and overdue taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 三月丁亥朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Third month, day dinghai new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai new moon of the third month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，賜劉理順等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Liu Shun and others were granted advanced scholar and other degrees in differing ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Liu Shun and others received advanced scholar and other degrees in differing ranks.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，張應昌擊賊於五嶺山，敗績。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Zhang Yingchang attacked the bandits at Wulingshan and suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Zhang Yingchang attacked the bandits at Wulingshan and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，賊自四川走湖廣，副將楊世恩追敗之于石河口。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: the bandits fled from Sichuan into Huguang; Vice General Yang Shi'en pursued and defeated them at Shihekou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the bandits fled from Sichuan into Huguang; vice general Yang Shi'en pursued and routed them at Shihekou.

sentences.zh: 山西自去年不雨至於是月，民大饑。

translations.literal: Shanxi had had no rain since the previous year until this month; the people suffered great famine.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi had had no rain since the previous year until this month, and the people were in grievous famine.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，賊自湖廣走盧氏、靈寶。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month: the bandits fled from Huguang toward Lushi and Lingbao.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer the bandits fled from Huguang toward Lushi and Lingbao.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，發帑振陝西、山西饑。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: treasury funds were released to relieve famine in Shaanxi and Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou treasury funds were released to relieve famine in Shaanxi and Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 五月丙申，副將賀人龍等敗賊于藍田。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingshen: Vice General He Renlong and others defeated the bandits at Lantian.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingshen, Vice General He Renlong and others defeated the bandits at Lantian.

sentences.zh: 六月辛未，總督侍郎陳奇瑜、鄖陽撫治都御史盧象升會師於上津，剿湖廣賊。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinwei: Supreme Commander Vice Minister Chen Qiyu and Yunyang Pacification Commissioner Lu Xiangsheng united their armies at Shangjin to suppress the Huguang bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinwei, supreme commander Chen Qiyu and Yunyang pacification commissioner Lu Xiangsheng joined forces at Shangjin to suppress the Huguang bandits.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，河決沛縣。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: the Yellow River burst its banks at Peixian.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the Yellow River burst its banks at Peixian.

sentences.zh: 是夏，官軍圍高迎祥、李自成諸賊于興安之車箱峽兩月。

translations.literal: That summer, government troops besieged the bandits Gao Yingxiang, Li Zicheng, and their followers in Chexiang Gorge in Xing'an for two months.
translations.idiomatic: That summer government troops besieged Gao Yingxiang, Li Zicheng, and their followers in Chexiang Gorge in Xing'an for two months.

sentences.zh: 賊食盡，偽降。

translations.literal: The bandits' food was exhausted and they feigned surrender.
translations.idiomatic: When their provisions were exhausted the bandits feigned surrender.

sentences.zh: 陳奇瑜受之，縱出險。

translations.literal: Chen Qiyu accepted them and let them out of the defile.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Qiyu accepted the surrender and let them out of the gorge.

sentences.zh: 復叛，陷所過州縣。

translations.literal: They rebelled again and seized the prefectures and counties they passed through.
translations.idiomatic: They rebelled again and overran the prefectures and counties in their path.

sentences.zh: 張應昌自清水追賊，敗績。

translations.literal: Zhang Yingchang pursued the bandits from Qingshui and suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yingchang pursued the bandits from Qingshui and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬辰，大清兵入上方堡，至宣府。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renchen: Great Qing troops entered Shangfang Fort and reached Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renchen, Great Qing troops entered Shangfang Fort and advanced to Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔總兵官陳洪范守居庸，巡撫保定都御史丁魁楚等守紫荊、雁門。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: an edict ordered Regional Commander Chen Hongfan to defend Juyong, and Baoding Grand Coordinator Ding Kuitai and others to defend Zijing and Yanmen.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the court ordered regional commander Chen Hongfan to hold Juyong and Baoding grand coordinator Ding Kuitai and others to hold Zijing and Yanmen.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: the capital was placed under strict guard.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the capital was placed under strict guard.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，大清兵克保安，沿邊諸城堡多不守。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Great Qing troops took Bao'an; along the frontier many forts and strongholds were abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Great Qing troops took Bao'an, and many frontier forts and strongholds were abandoned.

sentences.zh: 八月，分遣總兵官尤世威等援邊。

translations.literal: Eighth month: regional commanders including You Shiwei were dispatched in separate columns to reinforce the border.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month regional commanders including You Shiwei were sent in separate columns to reinforce the border.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，宣大總督侍郎張宗衡節制各鎮援兵。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Xuanda Supreme Commander Vice Minister Zhang Zongheng took overall command of the relief armies from the various garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Xuanda supreme commander Zhang Zongheng took overall command of relief armies from the various garrisons.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲申，賊陷隆德、固原，參議陸夢龍赴援，敗沒。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day jiashen: the bandits took Longde and Guyuan; Participating Secretary Lu Menglong went to the rescue and was defeated and killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on jiashen, the bandits took Longde and Guyuan; participating secretary Lu Menglong marched to relieve them and was defeated and killed.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，大清兵克萬全左衛。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Great Qing troops took Wanquan Left Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Great Qing troops took Wanquan Left Guard.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，旋師出塞。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: the army withdrew beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the army withdrew beyond the passes.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，李自成圍賀人龍於隴州。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Li Zicheng besieged He Renlong at Longzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Li Zicheng besieged He Renlong at Longzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申，盔甲廠災。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengshen: the armor works burned.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengshen, the armor works burned.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，洪承疇解隴州圍。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Hong Chengchou lifted the siege of Longzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Hong Chengchou lifted the siege of Longzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以賊聚陝西，詔河南兵入潼、華，湖廣兵入商、雒，四川兵由興、漢，山西兵出蒲州、韓城，合剿。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: because the bandits had massed in Shaanxi, an edict ordered Henan troops into Tong and Hua, Huguang troops into Shang and Luo, Sichuan troops by way of Xing and Han, and Shanxi troops out from Puzhou and Hancheng for a combined suppression.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, because the bandits had massed in Shaanxi, the court ordered Henan troops into Tongzhou and Huazhou, Huguang troops into Shangzhou and Luozhou, Sichuan troops through Xing'an and Hanzhong, and Shanxi troops out from Puzhou and Hancheng for a combined campaign.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚戌，湖廣兵援漢中，副將楊正芳戰死。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengxu: Huguang troops went to relieve Hanzhong; Vice General Yang Zhengfang died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on gengxu, Huguang troops marched to relieve Hanzhong; vice general Yang Zhengfang was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚辰，逮陳奇瑜下獄，論戍。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengchen: Chen Qiyu was arrested and imprisoned, sentenced to penal service.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengchen, Chen Qiyu was arrested, imprisoned, and sentenced to penal exile.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，洪承疇兼攝五省軍務。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Hong Chengchou was additionally put in charge of military affairs in the five provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Hong Chengchou was additionally given charge of military affairs in the five provinces.

sentences.zh: 是冬，陝西賊分犯湖廣、河南，李自成陷陳州。

translations.literal: That winter, Shaanxi bandits divided to raid Huguang and Henan; Li Zicheng took Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Shaanxi bandits divided to raid Huguang and Henan, and Li Zicheng took Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 是年，暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Siam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Siam presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月乙卯，賊陷上蔡，連陷汜水、滎陽、固始。

translations.literal: Eighth year, spring, first month, day yimao: the bandits took Shangcai and in succession took Sishui, Xingyang, and Gushi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, spring, first month, on yimao, the bandits took Shangcai and then Sishui, Xingyang, and Gushi in succession.

sentences.zh: 己未，洪承疇出關討賊。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Hong Chengchou marched out of the passes to campaign against the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Hong Chengchou marched out of the passes to campaign against the bandits.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，張獻忠陷潁州。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Zhang Xianzhong took Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Zhang Xianzhong took Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，陷鳳陽，焚皇陵樓殿，留守硃國相等戰死。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Fengyang fell; the tower halls of the imperial tombs were burned, and the garrison commander Zhu Guoxiang and others died fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Fengyang fell; the tower halls of the imperial tombs were burned, and garrison commander Zhu Guoxiang and others died fighting.

sentences.zh: 壬申，徐州援兵至鳳陽。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Xuzhou relief troops reached Fengyang.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen relief troops from Xuzhou reached Fengyang.

sentences.zh: 張獻忠犯廬州，尋陷廬江、無為。

translations.literal: Zhang Xianzhong attacked Luzhou and soon took Lujiang and Wuwei.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xianzhong attacked Luzhou and soon took Lujiang and Wuwei.

sentences.zh: 李自成走歸德，與羅汝才復入陝西。

translations.literal: Li Zicheng fled to Guide and, with Luo Rucai, re-entered Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zicheng fled to Guide and, with Luo Rucai, re-entered Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 二月，張獻忠陷潛山、羅田、太湖、新蔡，應天巡撫都御史張國維禦卻之。

translations.literal: Second month: Zhang Xianzhong took Qianshan, Luotian, Taihu, and Xincai; Yingtian Grand Coordinator Zhang Guowei repulsed him.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Zhang Xianzhong took Qianshan, Luotian, Taihu, and Xincai; Yingtian grand coordinator Zhang Guowei drove him back.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以皇陵失守，逮總督漕運尚書楊一鵬下獄，尋棄市。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: because the imperial tombs had been lost, Grand Coordinator of Grain Transport Yang Yipeng was arrested and imprisoned, and soon executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, because the imperial tombs had been lost, grain transport grand coordinator Yang Yipeng was arrested and soon executed.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，總兵官鄧巳敗賊于羅山。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Regional Commander Deng Zhifeng defeated the bandits at Luoshan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou regional commander Deng Zhifeng defeated the bandits at Luoshan.

sentences.zh: 是月，曹文詔敗賊於隨州。

translations.literal: That month, Cao Wenchao defeated the bandits at Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month Cao Wenchao defeated the bandits at Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，張獻忠復走漢中，犯平涼、鳳翔。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month: Zhang Xianzhong again fled to Hanzhong and raided Pingliang and Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Zhang Xianzhong again fled to Hanzhong and raided Pingliang and Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，鄭芝龍擊敗海賊劉香，香自殺，眾悉降。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Zheng Zhilong defeated the pirate Liu Xiang; Xiang killed himself and all his followers surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Zheng Zhilong defeated the pirate Liu Xiang; Xiang killed himself and all his followers surrendered.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，洪承疇會師於汝州，分部諸將防豫、楚要害。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Hong Chengchou united his armies at Ruzhou and deployed the generals to guard the strategic points of Henan and Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Hong Chengchou united his armies at Ruzhou and deployed his generals to hold the strategic points of Henan and Huguang.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，川兵變于樊城，鄧巳自殺。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Sichuan troops mutinied at Fancheng; Deng Zhifeng killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Sichuan troops mutinied at Fancheng; Deng Zhifeng killed himself.

sentences.zh: 丙午，洪承疇西還，駐師靈寶。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Hong Chengchou returned west and encamped at Lingbao.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Hong Chengchou returned west and encamped at Lingbao.

sentences.zh: 五月乙亥，吳宗達致仕。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yihai: Wu Zongda retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yihai, Wu Zongda retired from office.

sentences.zh: 六月己丑，官軍遇賊于亂馬川，敗績。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jichou: government troops encountered the bandits at Luanma River and suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jichou, government troops met the bandits at Luanma River and were defeated.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，副將艾萬年、柳國鎮擊李自成于寧州之襄樂，戰沒。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Vice Generals Ai Wannian and Liu Guozhen attacked Li Zicheng at Xiangle in Ningzhou and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen vice generals Ai Wannian and Liu Guozhen attacked Li Zicheng at Xiangle in Ningzhou and were killed.

sentences.zh: 丙午，曹文詔追賊至真寧之湫頭鎮，遇伏，力戰死之。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Cao Wenchao pursued the bandits to Qiutou Fort in Zhenning, fell into an ambush, and died fighting after a fierce struggle.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Cao Wenchao pursued the bandits to Qiutou Fort in Zhenning, fell into an ambush, and died fighting.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲戌，少詹事文震孟、刑部侍郎張至發俱禮部侍郎兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiaxu: Junior Mentor Wen Zhenmeng and Vice Minister of Punishments Zhang Zhifa were both made Vice Ministers of Rites and Grand Secretaries of the Eastern Pavilion, participating in confidential affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiaxu, junior mentor Wen Zhenmeng and vice minister of punishments Zhang Zhifa were both made vice ministers of rites and grand secretaries of the Eastern Pavilion with a seat in confidential state affairs.

sentences.zh: 是月，張獻忠突硃陽關，總兵官尤世威敗績，賊復走河南。

translations.literal: That month, Zhang Xianzhong burst through Zhuyang Pass; Regional Commander You Shiwei suffered defeat, and the bandits again fled into Henan.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhang Xianzhong burst through Zhuyang Pass; regional commander You Shiwei was defeated, and the bandits again fled into Henan.

sentences.zh: 八月，李自成陷咸陽，賊將高傑降。

translations.literal: Eighth month: Li Zicheng took Xianyang; the bandit general Gao Jie surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Li Zicheng took Xianyang, and the bandit general Gao Jie surrendered.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔撤監視總理內臣，惟京營及關、寧如故。

translations.literal: Day renchen: an edict ordered the withdrawal of the supervising eunuchs who oversaw overall command; only the capital garrison and the Shanhai and Ningxia fronts were left as before.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen an edict ordered the withdrawal of supervising eunuchs from overall command; only the capital garrison and the Shanhai and Ningxia fronts were left unchanged.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，盧象升總理直隸、河南、山東、湖廣、四川軍務。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Lu Xiangsheng was made supreme commander of military affairs in Zhili, Henan, Shandong, Huguang, and Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Lu Xiangsheng was made supreme commander of military affairs in Zhili, Henan, Shandong, Huguang, and Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 九月辛亥，洪承疇督副將曹變蛟等敗賊于關山鎮。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinhai: Hong Chengchou directed Vice General Cao Bianjiao and others to defeat the bandits at Guanshan Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinhai, Hong Chengchou directed vice general Cao Bianjiao and others to defeat the bandits at Guanshan Fort.

sentences.zh: 李自成東走，與張獻忠合。

translations.literal: Li Zicheng fled east and joined Zhang Xianzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zicheng fled east and joined Zhang Xianzhong.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，官軍敗績于沈丘之瓦店，總兵官張全昌被執。

translations.literal: Day renxu: government troops suffered defeat at Wadian in Shenqiu; Regional Commander Zhang Quanchang was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu government troops were defeated at Wadian in Shenqiu, and regional commander Zhang Quanchang was captured.

sentences.zh: 壬申，王應熊致仕。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Wang Yingxiong retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Wang Yingxiong retired from office.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚辰，下詔罪己，辟居武英殿，減膳撤樂，示與將士同甘苦。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengchen: an edict blamed the emperor himself; he moved his residence to the Wuying Hall, reduced his meals, and withdrew music, showing that he shared hardship with the troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on gengchen, the emperor issued a self-reproach edict, moved his residence to the Wuying Hall, reduced his meals, and withdrew music to show that he shared hardship with his troops.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，戶部尚書侯恂請嚴征新舊逋賦，從之。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Minister of Revenue Hou Xun requested strict collection of new and old overdue taxes; the request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Minister of Revenue Hou Xun asked for strict collection of new and old overdue taxes, and the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，李自成陷陝州。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Li Zicheng took Shanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Li Zicheng took Shanzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚戌，何吾騶、文震孟罷。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengxu: He Wuyao and Wen Zhenmeng were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengxu, He Wuyao and Wen Zhenmeng were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 庚申，祀天於南郊。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Heaven was sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the court sacrificed to Heaven at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 總兵官祖寬破賊於汝州。

translations.literal: Regional Commander Zu Kuan defeated the bandits at Ruzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commander Zu Kuan defeated the bandits at Ruzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅，城鳳陽。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuyin: Fengyang was walled.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuyin, Fengyang was walled.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，盧象升、祖寬敗李自成於確山。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Lu Xiangsheng and Zu Kuan defeated Li Zicheng at Queshan.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Lu Xiangsheng and Zu Kuan defeated Li Zicheng at Queshan.

sentences.zh: 戊子，左良玉敗賊於閿鄉。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Zuo Liangyu defeated the bandits at Wenxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Zuo Liangyu defeated the bandits at Wenxiang.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，賊犯江北，圍滁州。

translations.literal: Day guisi: the bandits raided north of the Yangtze and besieged Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the bandits raided north of the Yangtze and besieged Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，老回回諸賊自河南犯陝西，洪承疇敗之於臨潼。
