translations.literal: Day yisi: the bandits led by Lao Huihui came from Henan to raid Shaanxi; Hong Chengchou defeated them at Lintong.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the bandits led by Lao Huihui came from Henan to raid Shaanxi; Hong Chengchou defeated them at Lintong.

sentences.zh: 是年，安南、暹羅、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Annam, Siam, and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Annam, Siam, and Ryukyu presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月甲寅，總理侍郎盧象升、祖寬援滁，大敗賊于硃龍橋。

translations.literal: Ninth year, spring, first month, day jiayin: Supreme Commander Lu Xiangsheng and Zu Kuan went to relieve Chuzhou and inflicted a great defeat on the bandits at Zhu Long Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, spring, first month, on jiayin, supreme commander Lu Xiangsheng and Zu Kuan marched to relieve Chuzhou and routed the bandits at Zhu Long Bridge.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，前禮部侍郎林釺以原官兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: former Vice Minister of Rites Lin Kan was restored to his former office and additionally made Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion, participating in confidential affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao former vice minister of rites Lin Kan was restored to his former office and additionally made grand secretary of the Eastern Pavilion with a seat in confidential state affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月，前副將湯九州及賊戰嵩縣，敗沒。

translations.literal: Second month: former Vice General Tang Jiuzhou fought the bandits at Songxian and was defeated and killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month former vice general Tang Jiuzhou fought the bandits at Songxian and was defeated and killed.

sentences.zh: 山西大饑，人相食。

translations.literal: Great famine struck Shanxi; men ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: Great famine struck Shanxi, and men ate one another.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，寧夏饑，兵變，殺巡撫都御史王楫，兵備副使丁啟睿撫定之。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: famine struck Ningxia; the troops mutinied and killed Grand Coordinator Wang Ji; Military Vice Commissioner Ding Qirui pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou famine struck Ningxia; the troops mutinied and killed grand coordinator Wang Ji, and military vice commissioner Ding Qirui pacified them.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以武舉陳起新為給事中。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: the military licentiate Chen Qixin was made a supervising secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao military licentiate Chen Qixin was made a supervising secretary.

sentences.zh: 三月，盧象升、祖大樂剿河南賊。

translations.literal: Third month: Lu Xiangsheng and Zu Dale suppressed the Henan bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Lu Xiangsheng and Zu Dale suppressed the Henan bandits.

sentences.zh: 高迎祥、李自成分部入陝西，餘賊自光化走湖廣。

translations.literal: Gao Yingxiang and Li Zicheng divided and entered Shaanxi; the remaining bandits fled from Guanghua into Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yingxiang and Li Zicheng divided their forces and entered Shaanxi, while the remaining bandits fled from Guanghua into Huguang.

sentences.zh: 振南陽饑，蠲山西被災州縣新舊二餉。

translations.literal: Famine at Nanyang was relieved; new and old double levies were remitted in disaster-stricken prefectures and counties of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Relief was sent for famine at Nanyang, and new and old double levies were remitted in disaster-stricken prefectures and counties of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊子，錢士升致仕。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuzi: Qian Shisheng retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on wuzi, Qian Shisheng retired from office.

sentences.zh: 五月壬子，詔赦協從諸賊。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renzi: an edict granted amnesty to bandits who had followed the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renzi, an edict granted amnesty to bandits who had followed the rebels.

sentences.zh: 願歸者，護還鄉，有司安置；

translations.literal: Those who wished to return would be escorted home and settled by the relevant offices;
translations.idiomatic: Those who wished to return home would be escorted back and resettled by the local authorities;

sentences.zh: 原隨軍自效者，有功一體敘錄。

translations.literal: those who originally wished to follow the army and serve on their own initiative would, if they achieved merit, be rewarded and recorded on the same footing.
translations.idiomatic: those who chose to remain with the army and prove themselves would, upon earning merit, receive rewards and promotion on the same terms as regular troops.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，延綏總兵官俞沖霄擊李自成于安定，敗績，死之。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Yan-Sui Regional Commander Yu Chongxiao attacked Li Zicheng at Anding, suffered defeat, and died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Yan-Sui regional commander Yu Chongxiao attacked Li Zicheng at Anding, was defeated, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 李自成犯榆林，賀人龍擊敗之。

translations.literal: Li Zicheng raided Yulin; He Renlong defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zicheng raided Yulin, but He Renlong routed him.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，免畿內五年以前逋賦。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: tax arrears in the capital region dating from more than five years back were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou tax arrears in the capital region older than five years were remitted.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，林釺卒。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yihai: Lin Qian died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yihai, Lin Qian died.

sentences.zh: 甲申，吏部侍郎孔貞運，禮部尚書賀逢聖、黃士俊，俱禮部尚書兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Vice Minister of Personnel Kong Zhenyun, Ministers of Rites He Fengsheng and Huang Shijun—all were made Ministers of Rites and Grand Secretaries of the Eastern Lodge, participating in state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Vice Minister of Personnel Kong Zhenyun and Ministers of Rites He Fengsheng and Huang Shijun were all appointed ministers of rites and grand secretaries of the Eastern Lodge with a seat in state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 己亥，總兵官解進忠撫賊於淅川，被殺。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Regional Commander Xie Jinzhong pacified bandits at Xichuan and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai regional commander Xie Jinzhong was pacifying bandits at Xichuan when he was killed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，內臣李國輔等分守紫荊、倒馬諸關。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day jiachen: eunuch officials Li Guofu and others were posted to guard separately the Zijing, Daoma, and other passes.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiachen, eunuch officials including Li Guofu were assigned to hold the Zijing, Daoma, and other passes.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，成國公硃純臣巡視邊關。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Duke of Cheng-guo Zhu Chunchen inspected the frontier passes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Duke of Cheng-guo Zhu Chunchen inspected the frontier passes.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔諸鎮星馳入援。

translations.literal: Day guichou: an edict ordered the garrisons to rush reinforcements.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou an edict ordered the frontier garrisons to march to the capital with all speed.

sentences.zh: 己未，大清兵入昌平，巡關御史王肇坤等死之。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Qing forces entered Changping; Frontier Inspector Wang Zhaokun and others died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Qing forces entered Changping; frontier inspector Wang Zhaokun and others were killed.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，巡撫陝西都御史孫傳庭擊擒賊首高迎祥於盩厔，送京師伏誅。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Shaanxi Governor Sun Chuanting attacked and captured the bandit chief Gao Yingxiang at Zhouzhi, sent him to the capital, and he was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Shaanxi governor Sun Chuanting captured the bandit chief Gao Yingxiang at Zhouzhi, sent him to the capital, and had him executed.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，諭廷臣助餉。

translations.literal: Day guihai: the court ministers were instructed to contribute military funds.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the court instructed its ministers to contribute to military pay.

sentences.zh: 甲子，兵部尚書張鳳翼督援軍，高起潛為總監。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Minister of War Zhang Fengyi supervised the relief army; Gao Qiqian served as grand overseer.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Minister of War Zhang Fengyi took command of the relief army, with Gao Qiqian as grand overseer.

sentences.zh: 是月，大清兵入寶坻，連下近畿州縣。

translations.literal: That month Qing forces entered Baodi and in succession captured nearby capital-district prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: That month Qing forces entered Baodi and in quick succession overran nearby prefectures and counties of the capital region.

sentences.zh: 八月癸酉，括勳戚文武諸臣馬。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guiyou: horses were requisitioned from nobles, consort kin, and civil and military officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guiyou, horses were requisitioned from ennobled princes, consort kin, and civil and military officials at court.

sentences.zh: 乙未，盧象升入援，次真定。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Lu Xiangsheng came to reinforce and halted at Zhending.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Lu Xiangsheng marched to reinforce the capital and encamped at Zhending.

sentences.zh: 丙申，唐王聿鍵起兵勤王，勒還國，尋廢為庶人。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Tang Prince Yujian raised troops to rescue the throne; he was compelled to return to his fief, and soon afterward was degraded to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Tang Prince Yujian raised troops to rescue the throne; he was forced back to his fief and soon afterward was reduced to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 是月，大清兵出塞。

translations.literal: That month Qing forces withdrew beyond the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Qing forces withdrew beyond the frontier.

sentences.zh: 九月辛酉，改盧象升總督宣大、山西軍務。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinyou: Lu Xiangsheng was reassigned as Governor-General of Xuan-Da and Shanxi military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinyou, Lu Xiangsheng was reassigned as governor-general of Xuan-Da and Shanxi military affairs.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙亥，工部侍郎劉宗周以論內臣及大學士溫體仁削籍。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day yihai: Vice Minister of Works Liu Zongzhou, for memorializing about eunuch officials and Grand Secretary Wen Tiren, was struck from the registers.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on yihai, Works vice minister Liu Zongzhou was struck from the registers for memorializing against eunuch officials and Grand Secretary Wen Tiren.

sentences.zh: 甲申，張獻忠犯襄陽。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Zhang Xianzhong raided Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Zhang Xianzhong raided Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 丙申，命開銀鐵銅鉛諸礦。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: an order was issued to open silver, iron, copper, and lead mines.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen an order was issued to open silver, iron, copper, and lead mines.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁未，蠲山東五年以前逋賦。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingwei: tax arrears in Shandong dating from more than five years back were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingwei, tax arrears in Shandong older than five years were remitted.

sentences.zh: 十二月，大清兵征朝鮮。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: Qing forces campaigned against Korea.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Qing forces campaigned against Korea.

sentences.zh: 是年，洪承疇敗賊於隴州，賊走慶陽、鳳翔。

translations.literal: That year Hong Chengchou defeated bandits at Longzhou; the bandits fled toward Qingyang and Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: That year Hong Chengchou defeated the bandits at Longzhou, and they fled toward Qingyang and Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: Siam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Siam sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月辛丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Tenth year, spring, first month, xinchou new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, on the xinchou new moon of the first month of spring, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丙午，老回回諸賊趨江北，張獻忠、羅汝才自襄陽犯安慶，南京大震。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: the Muslim rebel bands turned toward the north of the Yangzi; Zhang Xianzhong and Luo Rucai, from Xiangyang, raided Anqing, and Nanjing was shaken.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the Muslim rebel bands turned toward the lands north of the Yangzi; Zhang Xianzhong and Luo Rucai marched from Xiangyang against Anqing, throwing Nanjing into alarm.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，遣使督直省逋賦。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiaxu: envoys were dispatched to supervise tax arrears in the directly administered provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiaxu, envoys were sent to press for tax arrears in the directly administered provinces.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，賊犯潛山，總兵官左良玉、副使史可法敗之於楓香驛。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: bandits raided Qianshan; Regional Commander Zuo Liangyu and Vice Commissioner Shi Kefa defeated them at Fengxiang Post.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou bandits raided Qianshan; regional commander Zuo Liangyu and vice commissioner Shi Kefa defeated them at Fengxiang Post.

sentences.zh: 是月，朝鮮降於我大清。

translations.literal: That month Korea submitted to the Great Qing.
translations.idiomatic: That month Korea submitted to the Great Qing.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥，振陝西災。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinhai: disaster relief was provided for Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinhai, disaster relief was sent to Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，賜劉同升等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Liu Tongsheng and others were granted jinshi titles, palace degrees, and other ranks according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Liu Tongsheng and others received jinshi titles, palace degrees, and other ranks according to merit.

sentences.zh: 甲子，官軍援安慶，敗績於酆家店。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: government troops went to relieve Anqing and suffered defeat at Fengjia Post.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi government troops marched to relieve Anqing and were defeated at Fengjia Post.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊寅，大清兵克皮島，副總兵金日觀力戰死之，總兵官沈冬魁走石城島。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, day wuyin: Qing forces captured Pi Island; Vice Regional Commander Jin Riguan fought to the death; Regional Commander Shen Dongkui fled to Shicheng Island.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on wuyin, Qing forces captured Pi Island; vice regional commander Jin Riguan died fighting, and regional commander Shen Dongkui fled to Shicheng Island.

sentences.zh: 癸巳旱，清刑獄。

translations.literal: Day guisi: because of drought, criminal cases were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, because of drought, criminal cases were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 是月，洪承疇剿賊于漢南。

translations.literal: That month Hong Chengchou suppressed bandits in southern Han.
translations.idiomatic: That month Hong Chengchou suppressed bandits in southern Han.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬寅，敕群臣潔己愛民，以回天意。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day renyin: the ministers were charged to purify themselves and love the people, so as to move Heaven's mind.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on renyin, the ministers were charged to discipline themselves and care for the people, so as to move Heaven's mind.

sentences.zh: 江北賊分犯河南，總督兩廣都御史熊文燦為兵部尚書，總理南京、河南、山、陝、川、湖軍務，駐鄖陽討賊。

translations.literal: Bandits from north of the Yangzi split off and raided Henan; Governor-General of Guangdong-Guangxi and Censor-in-Chief Xiong Wencan was made Minister of War with overall charge of military affairs in Nanjing, Henan, Shandong, Shaanxi, Sichuan, and Huguang, stationed at Yunyang to suppress bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits from north of the Yangzi split off and raided Henan; Guangdong-Guangxi governor-general and censor-in-chief Xiong Wencan was made minister of war with overall charge of military affairs in Nanjing, Henan, Shandong, Shaanxi, Sichuan, and Huguang, and was stationed at Yunyang to suppress the rebels.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，李自成自秦州犯四川。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuyin: Li Zicheng from Qinzhou raided Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuyin, Li Zicheng marched from Qinzhou into Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 六月戊申，溫體仁致仕。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wushen: Wen Tiren retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wushen, Wen Tiren retired from office.

sentences.zh: 是夏，兩畿、山西大旱。

translations.literal: That summer the two capitals regions and Shanxi suffered severe drought.
translations.idiomatic: That summer the two metropolitan regions and Shanxi suffered severe drought.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，山東、河南蝗，民大饑。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn: Shandong and Henan suffered locusts; the people suffered severe famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn locusts ravaged Shandong and Henan, and the people suffered severe famine.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，吏部侍郎劉宇亮、禮部侍郎傅冠俱禮部尚書，僉都御史薛國觀為禮部侍郎，並兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiyou: Vice Minister of Personnel Liu Yuliang and Vice Minister of Rites Fu Guan were both made Ministers of Rites; Vice Censor-in-Chief Xue Guoguan was made Vice Minister of Rites; all concurrently were Grand Secretaries of the Eastern Lodge, participating in state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiyou, Personnel vice minister Liu Yuliang and Rites vice minister Fu Guan were both made ministers of rites, and vice censor-in-chief Xue Guoguan was made vice minister of rites; all three were also appointed grand secretaries of the Eastern Lodge with a seat in state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 庚申，閱城。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: the city walls were inspected.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the city defenses were inspected.

sentences.zh: 九月丙子，左良玉敗賊於虹縣。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingzi: Zuo Liangyu defeated bandits at Hong County.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingzi, Zuo Liangyu defeated bandits at Hong County.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，洪承疇敗賊於漢中。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Hong Chengchou defeated bandits at Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Hong Chengchou defeated bandits at Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，李自成陷寧羌。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Li Zicheng took Ningqiang.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Li Zicheng took Ningqiang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申，自成自七盤關入西川。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day bingshen: Zicheng entered western Sichuan through Qipan Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on bingshen, Zicheng entered western Sichuan through Qipan Pass.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，陷昭化、劍州、梓潼，分兵趨潼川、江油、綿州，總兵官侯良柱戰死，遂陷彰明、鹽亭諸縣。

translations.literal: Day renyin: he took Zhaohua, Jianzhou, and Zitong; dividing his forces he pressed toward Tongchuan, Jiangyou, and Mianzhou; Regional Commander Hou Liangzhu died in battle, and he then took Zhangming, Yanting, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he took Zhaohua, Jianzhou, and Zitong; dividing his forces he pressed toward Tongchuan, Jiangyou, and Mianzhou; regional commander Hou Liangzhu died fighting, and he then overran Zhangming, Yanting, and other counties.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，逼成都。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: he pressed on Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he pressed on Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚辰，以星變修省，求直言。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengchen: because of a celestial anomaly, self-examination and frugality were practiced and blunt counsel was sought.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengchen, because of a celestial anomaly the court practiced self-examination and frugality and called for blunt counsel.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯，黃士俊致仕。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guimao: Huang Shijun retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guimao, Huang Shijun retired from office.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，洪承疇、曹變蛟援四川，次廣元。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Hong Chengchou and Cao Bianjiao went to reinforce Sichuan and halted at Guangyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Hong Chengchou and Cao Bianjiao marched to reinforce Sichuan and encamped at Guangyuan.

sentences.zh: 是年，安南、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: That year Annam and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Annam and Ryukyu sent tribute missions.
